# Noah Berman

> Personal site of Noah Berman — commercial pilot, software engineer, and Denver-based founder. Builds Freedom Aviation (aircraft management and flight instruction) and The Language School, plus AI and aviation technology projects.

## Pages

- [Home](https://noahiberman.com/): bio, ventures, and an interactive flight map of Noah's flying history
- [Blog](https://noahiberman.com/blog): writing on aviation, engineering, and entrepreneurship
- [Book a meeting](https://noahiberman.com/book): scheduling links for meetings with Noah
- [iNoah](https://noahiberman.com/inoah): AI chat assistant that answers questions about Noah

## Ventures

- [Freedom Aviation](https://freedomaviationco.com): concierge aircraft management and flight instruction
- [The Language School](https://thelanguageschool.us): English and Spanish language instruction
